title: mri-sph2surf
description: Converts spherical functional data to surface data in the FreeSurfer processing pipeline.

instem.description: Input stem of a bfloat file. The full input file name must take the form instem-lh_000.bfloat (or rh).
instem.title: Input stem

outstem.description: Output stem for the resulting file. The output file will have the name outstem-lh.w (or rh).
outstem.title: Output stem

hemi.description: Specifies the hemisphere for processing. Acceptable values are 'lh' or 'rh'.
hemi.title: Hemisphere

subject.description: Specifies the subject identifier for the FreeSurfer processing pipeline.
subject.title: Subject
